channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Joffrey Lauvergne | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Joffrey Lauvergne from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Nando De Colo, Evan Fournier, Rudy Gobert, Joffrey Lauvergne, Thomas Heurtel
item.description:
“I think people in the U.S. don't really know them. Those guys can really play. I mean, De Colo was the MVP of the EuroLeague, and Heurtel was the best prospect in EuroLeague, too. And we've got Rudy Gobert coming, and Joffrey Lauvergne, and Evan Fournier is pretty good, too. So, we have a lot of guys that have been drafted the last two years or so on good teams in the NBA. It's going to be a different era, of course, but it's still going to be good.”

Nicolas Batum on Nando De Colo, Evan Fournier, Rudy Gobert, Joffrey Lauvergne, Thomas Heurtel, Aug 15, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Michael Malone on Joffrey Lauvergne
item.description:
“Not just me but also (general manager) Tim (Connelly). He's a big part of what we're doing, but long term he's a big part of what we want to do. We believe in Joffrey Lauvergne. It's tough for him to hear that and not get the minutes that he's not getting at the moment, but you feel bad for guys like that because Joffrey is one of our hardest workers.”

Michael Malone on Joffrey Lauvergne, Jan 23, 2016. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Joffrey Lauvergne
item.description:
Still, coach Michael Malone insists Lauvergne is a big part of the Nuggets' future.

“With Joffrey, what I told him was whether you play ... or you don't play, I just want to reinforce to you how much we value you,”

Michael Malone on Joffrey Lauvergne, Jan 23, 2016. Source: Denver Post.
